one_sentence_story: A song gets stuck in your head because your speech and jaw zones sing it in silence. Chewing plain gum keeps those mouth plans busy and cuts stuck songs by a third.
so_what_for_you: Do not fight a stuck chorus with sheer willpower. Chew a piece of gum for two minutes or read a short page out loud to free your inner voice.
